Guild Info

Hello everyone, I am Darkfigher The Leader of this mery band of Runners. Just some notes about what you can expect from me and from the guild.


As a Guild we try to help eachother and the Community. A guild to us is not a bunch of people that run around and mass kill everything in site. Get the Uberest loot and lvl as fast as possible. Guilds are Families of people that enjoy talking to each other and spending time with each other. Don't get me wrong I love to go kill baddies with friends. So if you would like to be part of the family come take a look at Dark Wanderers


Guild News

Going StrongHola Everyone,

Well just wanted to stop by and say that the guild is doing great everday that I log on I always see at least a couple of you if not a full groups worth. We may not be the biggest guild out there atm, but we we have are quality players with great attitudes. I can't stop bragging about how great you all are.

In other News Bank is now updated as of everything up to Today. was a lot of stuff to add im sorry that i got so behind on it.

Also going to try and put up some new Forum topics as per Alex's Request!! If i can figure out how that is  :-( Bear with me guys im getting there!!!

Once again TY all for being a part of this and BTW last patch was AWESOME if you have not logged on recently give it a shot you will be suprised with all the changes.


Guild Bank Opened Today 04/16/08 Hopefully this will make it a little easier then trying ot post them all in game when someone gets on.

Guild Founded Today 04/14/08 Web Page was put up although many many changes and adjustments will have to be made! Swiper was also made First Officer.
